slides.heading: Bring these up at your visit

caption:
Ever wondered why your chiropractor asks so many questions before doing anything?

A good adjustment starts well before anyone touches your spine. Your history, some screening questions and simple movement and nerve checks help your chiropractor work out what's likely going on and what suits you.

Sometimes that means an adjustment. Sometimes it means soft tissue work, mobilisation, exercises, or a referral to your GP or one of our physios. You're always welcome to ask questions or say no to any technique.

At Hybrid Physio, our chiropractors work alongside our physios, Pilates instructors and remedial massage therapists. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
